description: This file defines the DdlReader class, which provides methods to read and parse DDL data into Document and DocumentObject instances, supporting multiple input sources such as streams, filenames, and strings.

classes.name: DdlReader
classes.description: A class that reads DDL data from various sources and parses it into Document or DocumentObject instances.

methods.name: DdlReader
methods.description: Constructors for initializing DdlReader with different input sources and optional error management.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the underlying stream or reader if it was set to do so.

methods.name: ReadDocument
methods.description: Reads all data from the input source and parses it into a Document object.

methods.name: ReadObject
methods.description: Reads all data from the input source and parses it into a DocumentObject.

methods.name: DocumentFromFile
methods.description: Static method to create a Document from a file.

methods.name: DocumentFromString
methods.description: Static method to create a Document from a DDL string.

methods.name: ObjectFromFile
methods.description: Static method to create a DocumentObject from a file, with optional error management.

methods.name: ObjectFromString
methods.description: Static method to create a DocumentObject from a DDL string, with optional error management.
